milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check for 'quartz' (Nether Quartz item) in inventory because mining nether_quartz_ore drops the quartz item, which ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no quartz, so any quartz in inventory confirms successful mining of the ore.

Uses inventory_has to check for 'quartz_block' in inventory because mining a quartz_block with a pickaxe drops the block itself, which ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no quartz_block in inventory, so any quartz_block present confirms successful mining.
